resolve_code/resolve_handle before scope: known digests map to their organization; unknown, malformed and retired return NULL
reserve_code: reserved, expired, revoked, exhausted, too_many_reservations at 10 live (expired ones not counted); unknown, foreign, unscoped and malformed refuse with no row; presignup never counts

record_pending_admission: pending (24 h, identity-bound, reservation consumed, one audit event), reservation_expired, expired, revoked, exhausted by D7.17 arithmetic, already_member writes nothing; a repeated pending admission of one identity on one code returns the live one with no new row or event; foreign scope refuses

admit_redemption admitted: principal, epoch-1 membership, verbatim template grants, 30-day entitlement, redemption and one audit event in one call; single-use code with one pending admission admitted then exhausted; replay returns the stored result; changed payload, other identity, unknown and foreign pending refuse with no write

admit_redemption: exhausted status at max (2 of 2), already_member consumes nothing; an expired pending admission and one whose code was revoked, expired or (operator-forced) exhausted are each marked denied_for_reconciliation with one audit event and no grant, slot or count change; retries answer expired

concurrent last-slot races admit exactly one: two pending admissions (one pending, one exhausted), redemption versus new pending admission in both orders, two identical redemptions (admitted, replayed) with one slot consumed, and one identity through two codes (admitted, already_member with no write)

advance_member_epoch: own epoch advances with one audit event per sign-out reason; another principal, stale epoch, foreign scope and any other reason refuse with no write; it waits on the member row and refuses after a concurrent epoch move

audit chains verify per organization: every hash recomputed in chain_sequence order from the genesis head, tail equals head; a tampered event fails verification; every redemption resolves to its own admission.redeemed event

limits: Local trust authentication is not RDS IAM/TLS qualification.
Operator-seeded contract shapes are not source import, hosted identity or successful application business writes.

Admission functions are exercised directly as genui_workspace with fixture codes written as the operator channel would; the storage-module admission path, the operator package, sessions and hosted identity are not exercised.
Native pool cancellation/reuse and actual managed trials remain separate.
